t: You're standing by a building in Kensington that houses Marks and Spencer, British Home Stores and the Roof Garden. It was designed by Bernard George, who lived from 1894 to 1964. He was an architect and a member of the Royal Institute of British Architects. There's not much more I can say with confidence about this one, but it's worth looking up at the building as a whole, since it was the work of a single architect.
